title: Know that `pnpm run validate` does not cover contract rules 4, 7 and 8: they only run in `pnpm test`
body:
The 8 contract rules and where each one is enforced:
1 No hand-written duration or seniority in any Prose: `checkRules` in content/schema/validation.ts (`collectProse` walks short AND long). validate.
2 No two overlapping full-time roles unless one has `concurrent: true`: `checkRules` (`overlaps`). validate.
3 A `core` skill needs evidence (an achievement citing it): `checkRules`. validate.
4 A Metric with `confidence: "estimated"` renders with "~"/"aprox.": `formatMetric` in content/schema/format-metric.ts, the ONLY place a Metric becomes text. pnpm test.
5 Every Media has a non-empty `alt`: Zod `media.alt.min(1)`. validate.
6 `approved: false` is never rendered: `resolveView` filters `t.approved` AND `checkRules` warns. validate + runtime.
7 `cv-short` cuts by priority: `PRIORITY_CUTOFF` / `MAX_ACHIEVEMENTS_PER_ROLE` in content/schema/resolve-view.ts. pnpm test (content/source/content-source.test.ts).
8 `streetAddress`/`phone` only leave on surfaces listed in `publishPhoneOn`: identity filtering in resolve-view.ts. pnpm test.
Also in `checkRules` (rule 0): referential integrity of roleId/projectId/skillId, and Skill.periods coherence (end after start, no overlap).
So a green `validate` says nothing about 4, 7, 8: run `pnpm test` too. If a rule fails, fix the DATA, not the rule — the rules are CI gates, not suggestions.
not_derivable: The rule list lived in docs/CONTRACT.md, which is being deleted; no single file maps rule numbers to the command that checks them, and validate's green output implies coverage it does not have.

evidence.summary: checkRules carries `// Rule 1/2/3/6` blocks (lines ~320-422); Zod media.alt carries Rule 5 (line 79).
Rule 7 constants PRIORITY_CUTOFF/MAX_ACHIEVEMENTS_PER_ROLE (lines 34-45); Rule 8 identity filtering (line 136); approved filter (line 178).
Header: the only place a Metric becomes text; rule 4.
